question: What condition affects even the wise at the tip of nectar?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar.
An essence of juice is involved.
Even the wise one is described as burning.
inference: Even a wise person experiences a burning condition at the tip of nectar.
uncertainties: The physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is esoteric.
plain_english: Even the wise one is burning at the tip of nectar with the essence of its juice.
